canonical_seed.student_text: A 24 N book rests on a table while a hand pushes downward with 6 N. First determine the support force, then determine the net vertical force.
canonical_seed.student_html: A 24 N book rests on a table while a hand pushes downward with 6 N. First determine the support force, then determine the net vertical force.
canonical_seed.answer: Support force = 30 N upward; net vertical force = 0 N.
canonical_seed.solution_text: For rest, support must balance both downward forces: 24+6=30 N. Using that intermediate result, 30−24−6=0 N.
canonical_seed.solution_html: For rest, support must balance both downward forces: 24+6=30 N. Using that intermediate result, 30−24−6=0 N.

canonical_seed.student_text: A crate has a 90 N upward support force and 70 N downward weight. A strap also pulls 15 N downward. First combine support and weight, then include the strap to find the final net vertical force.
